answer: The MAD data landscape, introduced in Chapter 1, refers to the complex and ever-evolving set of technologies related to machine learning (ML), artificial intelligence (AI), and data. [Ch. 4] This landscape highlights the transient nature of many technologies, with successful ones often fading into obscurity after a few years of rapid adoption. [Ch. 4]

citations.quote: Just consider the number of technologies in Matt Turck’s (in)famous depictions of the ML, AI, and data (MAD) landscape that we introduced in Chapter 1 (Figure 4-1).
